hook: The $13.99 fix for Hemnes's 30-inch bottom drawer

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide bottom Hemnes drawer open, clothes piled unevenly like a laundry basket
scenes.on_screen_text: 30 5/8" wide. Rigid bins don't work here.
scenes.voiceover: The bottom drawers on Hemnes run close to 30 inches wide.

scenes.visual_prompt: A small rigid plastic cube organizer placed in the wide drawer, visible dead space on both sides
scenes.voiceover: Small rigid cells just leave dead space at this scale.

scenes.visual_prompt: Unboxing the 6-pack of fabric bins, shown collapsed flat before use
scenes.voiceover: This 6-pack of collapsible fabric bins is built for exactly this width.

scenes.visual_prompt: Bins popping into shape in seconds as hands unfold them
scenes.voiceover: No assembly, they pop into shape and go straight in the drawer.

scenes.visual_prompt: Folding t-shirts and sweaters into the fabric bins inside the drawer
scenes.voiceover: Reviewers flag that heavy folded jeans can sag the sides a bit.

scenes.visual_prompt: Finished wide drawer with three distinct fabric bin zones, neatly filled
scenes.voiceover: For light knits and tees, it holds shape fine.

scenes.visual_prompt: Drawer closing, CTA text appears on screen
scenes.voiceover: Details and the exact link are in the post, link's in bio.

caption: My Hemnes's bottom drawer is basically a laundry basket without a fabric bin set. Rigid organizers just float around in 30 inches of space — this $13.99 six-pack is built for that width instead. I'm not hiding the one real complaint either. Full review linked in bio. Contains affiliate links.
